# Vera's Money

> A picture-led money game for one player: an amount is shown, and the player taps Australian coins and notes from a till into a tray until it holds exactly that amount.

The site is built for Vera, a stroke survivor who uses one hand (her left) and cannot read sentences. The interface has no instructions or labels: every control is a picture, an icon, or a colour, and the only text is dollar amounts. It has three levels ($1-$10 in 5c steps, $10-$100, and $100-$1000 in $5 steps) and a free play mode with a large running total. It is a static Next.js site with no server, no accounts, and no data collection.

- [Home page](/): The game itself: level choice, the till, the tray, and free play
